question: By how much did the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fall short of the baseline's?
rendered: The baseline's first charge capacity was 205.6 mAh/g, while the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity was 194.0 mAh/g. The recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fell short of the baseline's by 11.6 mAh/g, or 5.66% (11.6/205.6 * 100).
